div.div:
router.py (/api)
GET /feed (nearby | following | top + period), /feed/options
GET /feed/deeds/{id}
GET /public/deeds/{id} (no login; no-store, noindex)
GET /users/{handle}/social, /feed/users/{handle}/deeds
PUT/DELETE /feed/deeds/{id}/like, /save
POST /feed/deeds/{id}/shares, /hide, /show
GET/POST /feed/deeds/{id}/comments
DELETE /feed/comments/{id}
PUT/DELETE /users/{handle}/follow
GET /me/saved, /me/followers, /me/following
DELETE /me/followers/{handle}
GET /feed/me/notices, /feed/me/comment-notices (+ seen)
POST /feed/comments/{id}/reports
ReviewerUser: GET /admin/comment-reports (+ /{id}),
POST .../decision, POST /admin/comments/{id}/restore

div.div: Rules (M3-DESIGN §0). Visibility lives in feed_posts, separate from deed status, counts and prize fields; nothing in scoring may import feed (D36, test_architecture). Only verified deeds appear (Q23); one post per verified report (Q27); area name only, never coordinates (D39). Reading the feed needs a signed-in user; liking, commenting, saving, following and comment reports need onboarding (D44). Feed imports media.service, deeds.service and identity.service; media never imports feed outside its router (D30).
